# Julian Schelb

> NLP researcher at the University of Konstanz, with a background in software engineering and data science consulting. Research on detecting intertextuality in Latin literature, evaluating large language models, and using web data for the social sciences.

## Profile

- Website: https://julian-schelb.com/
- GitHub: https://github.com/julianschelb
- ORCID: https://orcid.org/0009-0002-8034-7364
- Hugging Face: https://huggingface.co/julian-schelb
- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/julian-schelb/

## Key publications

- Loci Similes: A Benchmark for Extracting Intertextualities in Latin Literature (Findings of EMNLP): https://arxiv.org/abs/2601.07533
- R.U.Psycho? Robust Unified Psychometric Testing of Language Models (LREC): https://aclanthology.org/2026.lrec-1.661/
- Assessing In-context Learning and Fine-tuning for Topic Classification of German Web Data (ACL SRW): https://aclanthology.org/2024.acl-srw.22
- ECCE: Entity-centric Corpus Exploration Using Contextual Implicit Networks (WWW Companion): https://doi.org/10.1145/3487553.3524237
- Tag-Pag: A Dedicated Tool for Systematic Web Page Annotations (preprint): https://arxiv.org/abs/2502.16150
- An Evaluation of Classifiers for Mapping Generative LLM Responses to Answer Options (EACL SRW): https://aclanthology.org/2026.eacl-srw.64/

## Software

- locisimiles (Python package for Latin intertextuality detection): https://github.com/julianschelb/locisimiles and https://pypi.org/project/locisimiles/
- rupsycho (psychometric testing of language models): https://github.com/julianschelb/rupsycho
- ECCE live demo: https://dimtools.uni-konstanz.de/ecce/
